items.title: Topstep’s migration journey: Self-managed Redis OSS to Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey
items.summary: Topstep migrated roughly 53 million keys from self-managed Redis OSS to a fully managed, Multi-AZ Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey cluster. Using RedisShake and a single Amazon Route 53 DNS change, the team completed a blue/green cutover in seconds with no application code changes beyond a small TLS configuration update.
items.creator: Gbeminiyi Abolarin
